text: That afternoon: Holmes says he thinks there was probably some more tangible cause
why: Paragraph 194 has Holmes say 'I think that there was probably some more tangible cause' as the visit is under way that afternoon.

text: That afternoon: Holmes says they must leave, bids Miss Stoner good-bye and tells her to be brave
why: Paragraph 194 has Holmes say 'we must leave you' and 'Good-bye, and be brave', so the farewell and the instruction are both stated.

text: How did Julia die? — Holmes does not think that she died from sudden fright
why: The question is one the story has prompted (Helen asked for the cause of death in ¶191), and ¶194 has Holmes say he does not think it was sudden fright. Julia is named in the story.
